description.value:
The deployed shield of the Militech Fortress Popup Shield cyberware. Equip this alongside the cyberware.

Install: Hospital
Cost: 1,500eb
Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6)

Paired Cyberarm Option. Takes up 2 Option Slots per arm. A large Popup shield installed in both Cyberarms that must be combined to use. When deployed , User gains a shield with 30HP and is unable hold items or use cyberlimb options from both Cyberarms. Any explosive damage that penetrates the Shield is halved against the User.

Foundry notes:

  • Halving explosive damage that gets through is not automated.

From Bontari Homebrew Cyberpunk Items by Bontari (Cyberware).
